target.title: Testimonials: prune 20 low-signal entries, add Pavan Davuluri and Rodrigo Farinha
target.body:
Quality pass over the shoutouts wall: 134 → 116 entries (−20 pruned, +2 added).

## Pruned (moved to testimonials-backup.json, recoverable)

Twenty low-signal entries: generic one-liners with no substance ("@openclaw is what you are looking for", "Feels like we're living in the future", "2026 is already the year of personal agents" — which never mentions OpenClaw), non-praise statements ("Essentially - you can automate almost anything…", "Nano banana and RSS parsing set up"), a model recommendation rather than OpenClaw praise (minimax-as-driver), one with off-tone wording ("hilarious, troubling, and awesome"), and assorted thin hype ("Shits about to get real!!!", "The future is now old man"). Full list in the diff; all preserved in the backup file per the repo's existing convention.

## Added (verified live via bird)

- **@pavandavuluri** (EVP, Windows + Devices) — "The Clawfather 🦞. Thank you for joining us at Build today @steipete!" — pairs with Satya's shoutout.
- **@rodrigofarinha** — "The speed of agents in this new version is incredible. Kudos to @steipete and the whole community 🦞"

Further mining rounds hit diminishing returns — remaining unharvested mentions are listicle spam, drama threads, and competitor promos. The wall now reads consistently: every entry is genuine, specific praise.

Avatars cached (243/243), `bun test` (25/25) and `bun run build` pass.
